spatial_disposition.evidence: Odisha government reference (https://puri.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-08/CHAPTER-II_23.pdf) establishes Gajapati rule from the Odisha/Cuttack region. No existing canonical first-class Place link, historical PolityPlaceFunction, verified spatial extent or reviewed static display binding has been established for this new polity. Hold spatial placement, rather than inventing coordinates or imperial territorial extents.

activity.notes: Kapilendra Deva (also Kapilesvara/Pratapa Kapilesvara) founded the Suryavamsi Gajapati dynasty after the Eastern Ganga rule of Odisha ended c.1434/35. Official Odisha historical chronologies variously give 1435–1467 and 1435–1466; both boundaries are approximate year-granularity, not exact death or accession days. Military reach in 1464 is not encoded as permanent territorial control. Gajapati Empire is a separate successor polity, not an alias of Eastern Ganga Kingdom (Odisha).

sources.title: Odisha Government — Chronological Accounts of Odisha History (Odisha Annual Reference 2017)
sources.citation_text: Official Odisha historical chronology identifies Kapilendra Dev as founder of the Orissan empire with a 1435–1467 reign and documents his imperial expansions by 1464.

sources.citation_text: The Odisha district gazetteer places the end of the Eastern Ganga succession in 1435 and attributes far-reaching southern conquests by 1464 to Kapilendra Deva.
